# Apple Woods

> Apple Woods is a planned, gated smart community in Brownsville, Texas, with Phase 1 homesites for sale from $85,000. The site presents the community concept, amenities, Phase 1 and Phase 2 homesite maps and price sheets, and a contact form for the sales team. Content is available in English and Spanish.

## Sections

- Community and Structured Living: what makes Apple Woods different from a standard lot purchase
- Amenities: clubhouse, pool, fitness, parks, event center, maintained surroundings
- Phase 1 and Phase 2 homesites: interactive lot maps and developer price sheets
- FAQ: general, cost, size, shared standards, and life in the community
- Location: Brownsville, TX
- Contact: inquiry form and direct sales contact

## Pages

- https://www.applewoods.us/ and https://www.applewoods.us/es: the community, amenities (planned), Phase 1 and Phase 2 maps and price sheets, FAQ, location, contact
- https://www.applewoods.us/lots and https://www.applewoods.us/es/terrenos: every lot type with list prices, Phase 1 and Phase 2 maps, what comes with a lot, building rules, dues, availability
- https://www.applewoods.us/blog and https://www.applewoods.us/es/blog: guides for buying a lot and building a home in Brownsville, TX
- https://www.applewoods.us/sitemap.xml lists every page in both languages

## Notes

- The home page keeps its sections at hash anchors (#phase-one, #location, #contact, #faq).
- Pricing and lot availability change; the price sheets on the page are the current reference.
